arena.poisoned: Dust in your eyes — charges at half speed

lair.pitch: One endless fight of chord changes. Every phase the colossus re-forms around a new progression — open chords, power chords, barre chords, sevenths — and the changes come quicker. See how far you get.

sword.body: Every clean change charges it: dead on 4, on time 3, close 2, loose 1. A chord counts once every string but one is heard. A missed change shatters the charge.

strike.body: A full sword strikes on its own — harder the longer your streak of clean changes, up to ×2 at {{max}} in a row.

bite.title: Every missed change is a fist
bite.body: A chord you don't get to in time costs HP. Run out and the run is over.

slam.title: Ride out the quake
slam.body: From phase {{slams}} the colossus quakes: for two bars the chords change twice as often. Play every one of them clean to block it — a block half-charges your sword.

endless.body: Clear a phase's HP and the colossus re-forms: a new progression, new chords and a quicker tempo every time. Open chords first, then power chords, barre chords and sevenths. Every phase cleared heals you {{heal}} HP.

threats.title: It learns
threats.body: From phase {{weak}} it finds your weak change — the one you miss most — and a clean one there charges your sword ×{{weakCharge}}. From phase {{affix}} it gains powers: dust, mending stone, aftershocks and petrify, which turns the tab to stone.

thorns.body: Every fist costs the colossus {{thornsPercent}}% of the phase's HP. Stacks.

secondWind.body: {{secondWindMisses}} missed changes each phase are forgiven: no fist, the streak and the charge stay.

steadyHand.body: A quake is still blocked with {{steadyHandQuakeMisses}} missed chord.

momentum.body: Your streak reaches ×2 at {{momentumStreak}} in a row instead of {{maxStreak}}.

exploit.body: Clean weak changes charge your sword ×{{exploitCharge}}.

briefing.same_speed: Changes come at the same speed

arena.quake_coming: Rush in a bar — the chords change twice as fast
arena.quake_on: Rush — land a tone of every chord · {{count}} left
arena.quake_on_steady: Rush — one chord may slip · {{count}} left

lair.pitch: One endless fight with nothing to read. Every phase the changeling takes on a new progression in a new key and becomes each chord in turn — solo over it. Hit the chord's notes on beats 1 and 3 and play the scale in between, and you wound it; anything else on those beats, or a note from outside the key, wounds you. See how far you get.

sword.body: On beats 1 and 3, play a note of the chord you're on — root, third, fifth or seventh — and it charges 4. In between, any note of the scale charges it: a chord tone 3, the rest 1, up to two notes a beat. The neck shows both: the chord's notes big, the scale's small.

strike.body: A full sword strikes on its own — harder the longer your streak of chord tones, up to ×2 at {{max}} in a row.

combo.title: Play the changes for a combo
combo.body: Land a new chord on the one — its first note within half a beat of the change — or step into it, its first note at most {{smooth}} semitones from the note before. Each is a trick: string them chord after chord, up to ×{{comboMax}}. The combo hits the changeling when the progression comes round, or when a chord lands without a trick. A miss loses it.

bite.title: Every chord needs a tone
bite.body: Play anything but a note of the chord first on beat 1 or 3, play a note from outside the key, or let a chord go by without one of its notes, and it claws you. Run out of HP and the run is over.

slam.title: Ride the rush
slam.body: From phase {{slams}} the changeling rushes: for two bars the chords change twice as fast. Land a tone of every one to block it — a block half-charges your sword.

endless.body: Clear a phase's HP and the changeling takes a new shape: a new key, one chord more and quicker changes every time — three different chords first. Now and then sevenths, a borrowed chord, a secondary dominant or a diminished one join in. Major and minor first, then the modes and the blues. Every phase cleared heals you {{heal}} HP.

threats.title: It learns
threats.body: From phase {{weak}} the guide tones — thirds and sevenths, the notes that say what a chord is — charge your sword ×{{weakCharge}}. From phase {{affix}} it gains powers: dissonance, reshaping, whirlwinds and a curtain drawn over the board.

thorns.body: Every claw costs the changeling {{thornsPercent}}% of the phase's HP. Stacks.

secondWind.body: {{secondWindMisses}} misses each phase are forgiven: no claw, the streak and the charge stay.

steadyHand.body: A rush is still blocked with {{steadyHandQuakeMisses}} chord let slip.

clearSight.body: The curtain stays down half as long.

precision.body: A tone right on the change charges {{precisionPoints}} instead of 4.

momentum.body: Your streak reaches ×2 at {{momentumStreak}} in a row instead of {{maxStreak}}.

briefing.same_speed: Chords change at the same speed

lane.title: Three chords, always
lane.body: At the top you always see three chords: the one playing now, the next one and the one after it. A line runs across the Now card — when it reaches the end, the next card slides into its place and that chord begins. The first phase has three chords; every phase after it brings one more.

accents.title: Beats 1 and 3: a note of the chord
accents.body: The accents fall on beats 1 and 3 of every bar — the taller marks. The first note you play on them has to be a note of the chord: it hits for 4 and the mark turns green. Anything else is a miss — the mark turns orange and the changeling claws you. On 2 and 4, and anywhere in between, play any note of the scale: each one charges your sword a little.

neck.title: Where to play
neck.body: The neck lights up one position and follows your hand. Big dots are the chord's notes — the ones for beats 1 and 3. Small dots are the rest of the scale, for in between. When the chord changes, so do the dots — over a chord from outside the key, the scale bends to fit it.

combo.title: Tricks and the combo
combo.body: Land a new chord right on its change (On the one), or step into it from a note at most two semitones away (Smooth). Tricks string together into a combo that hits the changeling when the progression comes round. One miss and the whole combo is gone.

watch.title: What hurts
watch.body: Each of these claws you and loses your combo:
watch.outside: A note from outside the key.
watch.strong: Anything but a note of the chord first on beat 1 or 3.
watch.silent: A chord let go by without a single one of its notes.
watch.rush: Orange chords are a rush: for two bars they change twice as fast — land a note of every one.
watch.headphones: Play with headphones on: the mic should hear your guitar, not the backing.

lair.skip_note_other: Skips {{count}} phases — clear phase {{phase}} to bank their HP into your score.

sword.title: Charge your sword
sword.body: Every hit charges it: dead on 4, on time 3, close 2, loose 1. A miss shatters the charge.

strike.title: Strike
strike.body: A full sword strikes on its own — harder the longer your streak, up to ×2 at {{max}} in a row.

bite.title: Every miss is a bite
bite.body: A missed note costs HP. Run out and the run is over.

slam.title: Block the slam
slam.body: From phase {{slams}} the spider winds up slams. Be on a streak of {{parry}} when one lands to block it — a block half-charges your sword.

endless.title: Endless and random
endless.body: Clear a phase's HP and the spider molts: a random finger order, route, position and rhythm, faster every time. Every phase cleared heals you {{heal}} HP.

draft.title: Pick a boon
draft.body: After every phase you take one of three boons dealt at random — armor, a sharper blade, a slower tempo… Some stack, the rare ones come seldom. One reroll per run, another every five phases.

threats.title: It learns
threats.body: From phase {{weak}} it shows weak spots — your sword charges ×{{weakCharge}} while one is open. From phase {{affix}} it gains powers: venom, regeneration, frenzy and webs spat over the tab, more of them the further you get.

gates.title: Gates and savepoints
gates.body: Every {{gate}}th phase the boss guards a gate: {{gateHp}}% more HP and harder bites. Reach a gate and your next run can start there — the phases you skip count toward your score once you clear the one you start at.

lifesteal.name: Lifesteal
lifesteal.body: Every strike heals you {{lifestealHp}} HP. Stacks.

thorns.name: Thorns
thorns.body: Every bite costs the spider {{thornsPercent}}% of the phase's HP. Stacks.

secondWind.name: Second wind
secondWind.body: {{secondWindMisses}} misses each phase are forgiven: no bite, the streak and the charge stay.

steadyHand.name: Steady hand
steadyHand.body: Block slams with a streak of just {{steadyHandStreak}}.

clearSight.name: Clear sight
clearSight.body: Webs over the tab last half as long.

lightBlade.name: Light blade
lightBlade.body: Your sword fills with {{lightBladePercent}}% fewer points. Stacks.

momentum.name: Momentum
momentum.body: Your streak reaches ×2 at {{momentumStreak}} in a row instead of 48.

exploit.name: Exploit
exploit.body: Weak spots charge your sword ×{{exploitCharge}} and stay open longer.

slowDown.name: Slow down
slowDown.body: −{{slowDownBpm}} BPM on every phase from now on.

overdrive.name: Overdrive
overdrive.body: +{{overdriveBpm}} BPM on every phase, but strikes deal {{overdrivePercent}}% more.
